description: This file defines the 'son_slave_thread' class, which manages a slave thread in a network agent, handling CMDU messaging, radio configurations, and interactions with other components like broker, platform, and backhaul managers. It includes class definitions, method declarations, and internal data structures for managing radio interfaces, CMDU processing, and agent state.

classes.name: slave_thread
classes.description: Manages a network agent's slave thread, handling CMDU messaging, radio interfaces, and interactions with other network components.

classes.name: sAgentConfig
classes.description: Configuration structure for the agent, including radio and interface settings.

classes.name: sManagedRadio
classes.description: Represents the state and configuration of a managed radio interface.

classes.name: cRadioManagers
classes.description: Manages multiple radio interfaces and zwdfs radio manager.
